lines.speaker: snooze
lines.en: Skip skincare. Go straight to sleep.
lines.or: ସ୍କିନକେୟାର ସବୁ ଛାଡ, ସିଧା ଯାଇ ଶୋଇପଡ!

lines.speaker: jar
lines.or: ଶୁଅ, ଠିକ ଅଛି। ମୋତେ ସ୍କିପ କରନି!

lines.speaker: jar
lines.en: I turn bedtime into brightening time.

lines.speaker: jar
lines.en: My 3Xpert formula works while you rest.
lines.bn: থ্রি এক্সপার্ট ফর্মুলা, ঘুমেও কাজ করে!
lines.ta: நீ தூங்கு, த்ரீ எக்ஸ்பர்ட் ஃபார்முலா வொர்க்!
lines.ml: ത്രീ എക്സ്പർട് ഫോർമുല, നീ ഉറങ്ങ്, ഞാൻ വർക്ക്!
lines.or: ଥ୍ରୀ ଏକ୍ସପର୍ଟ ଫର୍ମୁଲା, ନିଦରେ କାମ କରେ!

lines.speaker: jar
lines.en: Smooth on my rich night-cream texture.

lines.speaker: jar
lines.en: Fully absorbed. Now get your beauty sleep.
lines.bn: পুরো অ্যাবজর্বড! এবার বিউটি স্লিপ নাও।
lines.te: ఫుల్‌గా అబ్జార్బ్! ఇక బ్యూటీ స్లీప్ తీసుకో!
lines.or: ପୁରା ଅବଜର୍ବ! ଏବେ ବିଉଟି ସ୍ଲିପ ନିଅ!

lines.speaker: woman
lines.en: I slept. My glow showed up.
lines.bn: আমি শুধু ঘুমিয়েছি, আর গ্লো হাজির!

lines.speaker: jar
lines.en: DERMDOC two percent Kojic Acid Night Cream. Sleep to glow.
lines.bn: ডার্মডক কোজিক নাইট ক্রিম। স্লিপ টু গ্লো!
lines.ta: டெர்ம்டாக் கோஜிக் க்ரீம், ஸ்லீப் டு க்ளோ!
lines.te: డెర్మ్‌డాక్ కోజిక్ క్రీమ్, స్లీప్ టు గ్లో!
lines.ml: ഡെർമ്ഡോക് കോജിക് ക്രീം, സ്ലീപ് ടു ഗ്ലോ!
lines.or: ଡର୍ମଡକ କୋଜିକ ନାଇଟ କ୍ରିମ, ସ୍ଲିପ ଟୁ ଗ୍ଲୋ!

notes: Product-avatar ad. Cast from prompt labels: Snooze villain (lines 1, 5; ~242-264 Hz, playful), jar mascot (lines 2-4, 6, 7, 9; ~200-275 Hz), woman (line 8, ~198 Hz). Pitch separation in the source is weak: jar and woman are both ~200-210 Hz, and line 2 (jar, 275 Hz) is close to Snooze, so line 2 is left out of the jar clone refs. Jar gets +2 st and Snooze gets villain fx with -3 st so the three voices are clearly distinct. Whisper segment 5 ('...texture, fully absorbed') was split at the sentence boundary (12.32/12.54) to match the prompt's frame 6/7 lines. Line 9: Whisper heard 'Dearm percent Kojic Acid', which is DERMDOC 2% Kojic Acid; dubs drop 'two percent' and 'acid' (and 'night' in ta/te/ml) to fit the 2.1 s slot (the full name is on the end slate). 'Sleep to glow' tagline kept in English transliteration.
